items.title: CHART SEA LANE
items.placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
items.text:
CHART SEA LANE
Spend 2 Supply cubes in a port location (⚓) to draw a sea lane from it to another port location.

rules: Spend 2 Supply cubes in a port location. The port is marked with an anchor.
Draw a sea lane from that port to another port location.
mechanics.effect: Action: at a port, spend 2 Supply cubes to draw a sea lane to another port. The icon is two anchored circles joined by a line, and the same anchor is printed in parentheses after port location.

items.title: Reference card placement
items.text: Place this sticker on the back of each player reference card.

mechanics.effect: Place the Chart Sea Lane sticker on the back of each player reference card.

summary: Chart Sea Lane action overlay. Spend 2 Supply cubes in a port to draw a sea lane to another port. Place it on the back of each player reference card.
